### YEAR
Extracts the calendar year from a date, using the [query time zone](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/query-languages/esql/directives/set#esql-time_zone).
Equivalent to `DATE_EXTRACT("year", date)`.
This function accepts a `date` or `date_nanos` value. Unix timestamps in seconds must be converted first.
For example: `TO_DATETIME(start * 1000)`.

```esql
ROW dt = to_datetime("1996-03-21T00:00:00.000Z")
| EVAL year = YEAR(dt)
```
